QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_51

question.text: The purpose of the clearing corporation collecting different types of margins is to:

answer.text: Ensure adequate collateral to cover potential losses and guarantee settlement in all market conditions

explanation.text: The Logic: The clearing corporation collects margins, manages payment and delivery mechanisms, assumes counterparty risk, and guarantees financial settlement. Multiple margin types ensure adequate collateral across different risk scenarios — from normal daily movements (initial, MTM) to extreme events (ELM) and the delivery phase (tender margin) — so that settlement is guaranteed even in stressed markets. The Trap: Margins are a risk-management tool, not a revenue stream for the exchange. They are not designed to discourage retail participation, and they do not fund technology projects; their purpose is to protect the integrity of the settlement system.
